source_contract.standard_eprl_finiteness: Kaminski arXiv:1010.5384 proves integrability/finite regularized evaluation for every 3-edge-connected SL(2,C) spin-network with invariants of a specified class, covering EPRL intertwiners and some generalizations.
source_contract.toller_2026: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal PRD 114, 046014 / arXiv:2604.24945 establishes Toller T^(±) as polynomially bounded functions on the Lorentz group satisfying T^(+)+T^(-)=D; an individual branch is not itself the unitary SL(2,C) representation D.
source_contract.causal_vertex_2026: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal PRD 113, 126020 / arXiv:2601.23162 defines the causal Lorentzian EPRL vertex by replacing wedge D blocks with sign-selected Toller blocks.
source_contract.scope: Audit only whether the already-published standard EPRL 3-edge-connected integrability theorem can be automatically transferred to the fixed-causal Toller vertex from the presently frozen source properties. It does not calculate or claim divergence of the causal vertex.

scope_rule: A PASS only establishes an applicability gap: currently frozen source properties do not by themselves certify that the standard representation-based EPRL finiteness theorem applies to sign-selected Toller kernels. It must not be promoted to divergence, scientific FAIL, no-go, family terminality, stack cutoff closure, same-realization transport, or D7 authorization.
